verses.text: Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ak'b'at jaywanhok heb' winh winak, yik sb'at heb' winh yil lum Canaán, lum ol wak' t'ayex. Tza sik'el junjunok heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun inhtilal, tza chekanb'at heb' winh, xchi t'a winh.

Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Moisés cheknab'il ix yal Jehová chi'. Ix schekb'at heb' winh ix sik'el winh chi', ix el heb' winh t'a tzinan lum t'a yol yik Parán, ix b'at heb' winh yila' tas yilji lum Canaán chi'. Yajal yaj heb' winh smasanil t'a skal heb' yetisraelal.
Icha tik sb'i heb' winh yet' tastak yinhtilal:

Ha winhaj Samúa yuninal winhaj Zacur, t'a yinhtilal Rubén. Ha winhaj Safat yuninal winhaj Horí, t'a yinhtilal Simeón. Ha winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone, t'a yinhtilal Judá. Ha winhaj Igal yuninal winhaj José, t'a yinhtilal Isacar. Ha winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Nun, t'a yinhtilal Efraín. Ha winhaj Palti yuninal winhaj Rafú, t'a yinhtilal Benjamín. Ha winhaj Gadiel yuninal winhaj Sodi, t'a yinhtilal Zabulón. Ha winhaj Gadi yuninal winhaj Susi, t'a yinhtilal José, syalelk'ochi t'a yinhtilal Manasés. Ha winhaj Amiel yuninal winhaj Gemali, t'a yinhtilal Dan. Ha winhaj Setur yuninal winhaj Micael, t'a yinhtilal Aser. Ha winhaj Nahbi yuninal winhaj Vapsi, t'a yinhtilal Neftalí. Ha winhaj Geuel yuninal winhaj Maqui, t'a yinhtilal Gad.
Haton sb'i heb' winh ix schekb'at winhaj Moisés yil lum Canaán. (Ix k'exwi sb'i winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Nun yuj winhaj Moisés chi', Josué ix sb'i'ejkan winh yuj winh.)
Ayik ix yak'anb'at heb' winh ilum lu'um winhaj Moisés chi' t'a Canaán, ix yal winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ixikek, ha t'a Neguev tzex b'ati, tzex k'ek'och t'a tzalkixtak,
tzeyilani tas yilji lu'um. Tzeyilanpaxi tas yilji anima kajan ta', tek'an am heb' mato ma'ay. Scham heyilanpaxi, tzijtum am heb' mato jaywannhej heb'.
Tzeyilani, yoltak am mantiado kajan heb' anima chi' mato oyanoch muro t'a spatik schonhab' heb'. Tato wach' lu'um mato ma'ay,

tato yax sat lu'um mato takinh. Tzeyilani tato ay ste'al lu'um. Tzeyak' heyip heyik'ankot sat tas awab'il t'a sat lu'um chi', tzeyik'kot jab'ok kila', xchi winh t'a heb' winh. Ha t'a stiempo'al sb'ab'el sat te' uwa, hata' ix xit'ek' heb' winh chi'.
Ix el heb' winh t'a lum tzinan lum yik Zin masanto ix k'och heb' winh t'a Rehob t'a slak'anil Hamat.

Ix k'ek'och heb' winh t'a Neguev masanto ix k'och heb' winh t'a Hebrón. Hata' ay schonhab' winhaj Ahimán, winhaj Sesai yet' winhaj Talmai, yinhtilalkan winhaj Anac. Ha chonhab' Hebrón chi', ukexo ab'il sb'o'i ayik sb'onak chonhab' Zoán t'a Egipto.

Ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a jun ch'olan skuch Escol, hata' ix xikel jun k'ojlab' sat te' uwa heb' winh, ix stzek'anoch heb' winh t'a jun te te'. Chawanh heb' winh ix ik'ankoti, ix yak'ank'e heb' winh t'a sjolom sjenhjab'. Ix yik'anpaxkot sat te' granado heb' winh yet' sat te' higo.
Escol ix skuchkan jun ch'olan chi', yujto hata' ix xikel jun k'ojlab' sat te' uwa chi' heb' winh ilum lu'um chi'.
Ixlajwi yilan lum lum chi' heb' winh t'a 40 k'uhal, ix meltzaj heb' winh

t'a Cades, t'a tzinan lum t'a yol yik Parán. Hata' ayek' winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón yet' masanil heb' yetisraelal heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan heb' winh yalani chajtil yilji lum lum chi', ix sch'oxan sat te' awb'en te' ix yik'kot heb' winh chi' t'a lu'um.
Ix yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Toxo ix b'at kil lum lum ix ala', wal yel te wach' lu'um, te yax sat lu'um, ina sat tastak tz'el t'a sat lum tik.

Palta ha heb' anima kajan ta' te tek'an heb', yelxo wal niwak chonhab' yilji schonhab' heb'. Ayoch smuro'al spatiktak schonhab' heb' chi'. Hanhejtona' ix kilpax heb' winh winak te cha'anh ste'el, haton heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Anac.

Ha heb' amalecita kajan t'a sat lum Neguev, haxo t'a sikil lum yet' t'a tzalkixtak, hata' kajan heb' hitita yet' heb' jebuseo yet' pax heb' amorreo. Haxo pax t'a stitak ha ha' mar yet' t'a stitak ha' Jordán, ha heb' cananeo kajan t'ay, xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Caleb t'a masanil heb' israel linhanoch t'a yichanh winhaj Moisés chi' to numan tz'aj heb', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik koyek, kikxo yaj lu'um. Ol elnhej heb' winh chi' ku'uj, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi juntzanh heb' winh ix xit'ek' chi' icha tik: --Manh ol yal-laj kak'an owal yet' heb' chonhab' chi' yujto te tek'an heb' t'a kichanh, xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalan heb' winh t'a skal heb' chonhab' israel chi' to ha jun lum lum ix b'at yil heb' winh chi' chuklaj lu'um. Ix yalanpax heb' winh: --Ha lum xit' kil chi', scham anima yuj lu'um. Masanil heb' anima ix kil ta', te niwak winaknhej heb'.

Ix kilanpax heb' te cha'anh ste'el, heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Anac. Ha tzonh och linhan t'a stz'ey heb', lajan tzonh ajkan ichok nok' chil t'a skal yok heb'. Hanheja' icha chi' tzonh yutej yilanpaxoch heb', xchi heb' winh.
